permissions.name: userdirs:access
permissions.description: Have a personal file space, and manage everything inside it

permissions.name: userdirs:share
permissions.description: Make a file in your own space downloadable by anyone with the link

permissions.name: userdirs:others:browse
permissions.description: Open and download from any user's space

permissions.name: userdirs:others:manage
permissions.description: Upload to, rename, move and delete inside any user's space

permissions.name: userdirs:quotas
permissions.description: Change storage plans, per-user limits, and suspend or restore a space

settings.name: root_folder
settings.description: The folder in the file library that every user space is created inside

settings.name: auto_provision
settings.description: Create a user's space the first time they open it. With this off, an admin has to create it first

settings.name: usage_stale_minutes
settings.description: How old a cached usage figure may get before opening a space recalculates it in the background

groups.name: kempo-user-dirs:member
groups.description: Has a personal file space and can share files out of it. This is the group that gates the feature — nobody has a space until they are in it

groups.name: kempo-user-dirs:administrator
groups.description: Manages everyone's spaces: browsing, provisioning, storage plans and per-user limits
